name: veterinary_clinic_system_068_patient_species_weight_sanity
instruction: Sanity-check patient weights against species-typical ranges (verify typical ranges online if unsure): canine 1–90 kg, feline 1–15 kg, avian 0.02–2 kg, exotic 0.02–15 kg, equine 200–700 kg, other 0.02–200 kg. For every patient whose weight_kg falls outside its species range, set weight_flag='out_of_range' and weight_checked='<batch_code>'; for every in-range patient set weight_flag='plausible' (no tag field). Patients with missing weight get weight_flag='missing'. All other fields byte-identical.

success_criteria.summary: Recompute expected flag per patient from snapshot weights vs documented ranges; assert exact flag values and tag presence only on out_of_range rows; count 30.

checks.expect: Recompute expected flag per patient from snapshot weights vs documented ranges; assert exact flag values and tag presence only on out_of_range rows; count 30.
